description: This file contains assembly code for the startup routine of a MIPS-based system, specifically for loading an LZMA compressed kernel on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes code for relocation, cache management, BSS zeroing, and jumping to the main loader function.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: Assembly macro for the 'Execute Halt and Branch' operation to synchronize instructions on MIPS.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Main startup routine for initializing CPU registers, relocating code, clearing BSS, setting up stack, and jumping to the main loader.
